name: Orchestrator
description: Every 30 min 08:00–24:00 (paused at night): run each source (catch-up pagination after the pause) → merge → ids not in BigQuery → Claude enrichment → BigQuery load + Telegram. Source health: error or 0 listings twice in a row → alert.

nodeGroups.name: New listings
nodeGroups.description: New = id not in BigQuery yet; a deleted listing comes back if the site lists it again

nodeGroups.name: Claude enrichment
nodeGroups.description: Description (4zida) + cover photo (all sources) → fee, utilities, scam flag, photo quality; a failure does not stop ingest

nodeGroups.name: BigQuery load
nodeGroups.description: Batch load job (resumable upload, NDJSON), then poll the job until DONE; a load error fails the run

nodeGroups.name: Score
nodeGroups.description: 0–100 score from the listings_scored view (same formula as /top)

nodeGroups.name: Telegram
nodeGroups.description: Filter; same fingerprint as a flat already sent → Claude vision compares photos: same flat = one-line note, else full message

nodeGroups.name: Source health
nodeGroups.description: Error or 0 listings twice in a row → Telegram; reminder every ~6 h; message on recovery

versionMetadata.name: Same-flat check: up to 3 candidates, same-run listings
versionMetadata.description: MarkSameFlat keeps the last 3 flats per fingerprint (newest first) and adds each listing right away, so listings in the same run are compared with each other. BuildDupPair emits one pair per candidate; ApplyDupResult merges the verdicts (any isti → note pointing to the oldest match, otherwise full message).
